⚠️ Failure Symptom & Factory Service Manual Root Cause

Symptom on machine: Vacuum won't turn on when you pull the trigger and the battery indicator flashes red repeatedly, OR the red finger trigger feels floppy and doesn't click the power switch.

Verified technical root cause: Flashing red LED indicates lithium cell imbalance lockout inside the battery pack BMS; a floppy trigger with no LED lights on V10/V11 indicates the internal plastic trigger rib snapped.

🔧 Step-by-Step DIY Inspection & Replacement Checklist

  1. Plug the charger in: if the battery LED blinks red instead of solid blue, remove the 3 Phillips screws (one behind the upper handle, two under the bottom base) and slide in a new battery pack.
  2. If the battery charges solid blue on the dock but pressing the red trigger on your V10 or V11 does nothing and feels loose, install the reinforced heavy-duty trigger switch.
